for r in range(8):

    pts=[]

      dark=sum(1 for _,_,p in pts if sum(p)<300)

      out.append(f'{chr(97+c)}{8-r}:n{len(pts)} box{min(xs)-x0},{min(ys)-y0}-{max(xs)-x0},{max(ys)-y0} d{dark} w{white}')
  print(' | '.join(out) or '(empty)')
